messages.content: Help me plan this evening: what's for dinner at Birch, when does it close, and are there any campus events I could go to afterward?

parts.text: Tonight, Friday, September 4, Birch Tree Inn is serving dinner from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM. After that, Birch has a Late Night period from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM, so if you mean the dinner meal specifically, dinner ends at 8:00 PM; if you mean Birch’s overall service tonight, the last service ends at 11:00 PM.

Some of Birch’s published dinner items for tonight include BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwich at Sizzle, Buffalo Chicken Snowshoe Pizza and Cheese Pizza at Slices, Alfredo Sauce at Twists, Broccoli Florets at Showcase, Baked Breadsticks, Blue Ribbon Slaw, and American and Cheddar cheese at Stacked.

At the current campus time, 10:52 PM on Friday, September 4, the only published campus event from today’s results that is still running is CPB Carnival, scheduled from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Earlier events in the public feed—Broadway and Board Games, Duo’s Spikeball Tournament, and Frame Your Memories—were scheduled for 7:00 PM starts and have already ended.

The published event listing for CPB Carnival does not show a public location in the public feed; it is marked as a private location, so I can confirm the event time but not a public venue from the retrieved records.

Since dinner hours have already passed, Birch’s remaining option tonight would be Late Night until 11:00 PM. If you want something to do right afterward, CPB Carnival is the only event from today’s published results that still appears to be in progress.
